data.name: Jayaasri
data.gender_notes: Jayaasri is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jayaasri is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'jaya' meaning victory and 'asri' meaning prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Jayaasri is considered the goddess of victory, success, and good fortune. She is also known as the consort of Lord Ayyappan and is revered in various parts of India. The name Jayaasri carries the meaning “Victory, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jayaasri usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the triumph of good over evil and the attainment of spiritual success.
data.etymology: Jayaasri belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory, Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jayaasri total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
